macros.name: backtick
macros.doc: If you need a literal backtick, you may in any case use the macro \backtick.

macros.name: paren
macros.doc: It handles a parenthetic expression including parsing matching delimiters and adjusting their sizing.

macros.name: parenMakeBacktickActiveParen
macros.doc: You may use the command \parenMakeBacktickActiveParen to enable the backtick shorthand at any time in the document.

macros.name: parenMakeNormalBacktick
macros.doc: The command \parenMakeNormalBacktick changes the behavior of the backtick character in math mode to be a normal backtick char (“‘”).

macros.name: parenRegister
macros.doc: Register a new delimiter type with \parenRegister.
